title: Payment Gateway Timeout - Checkout Failures
description: Payment Gateway is experiencing intermittent timeouts causing ~15% of checkout transactions to fail.
impact: ~15% of transactions failing. Approximately 2,000 affected users per hour.
workaround: Route through backup gateway payment-bkp.internal. Set PAYMENT_FAILOVER=true in service config.

title: Payment Service Partial Outage
description: Checkout API and Payment Gateway experiencing elevated errors. ~15% of transactions are failing.
workaround: Backup gateway is available at payment-bkp.internal.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion - User Service
description: User service unable to acquire DB connections due to pool exhaustion.
impact: Login failures for ~500 users over 2 hours.
root_cause: Recent deployment increased concurrent DB calls without adjusting pool size.
resolution: Increased DB connection pool size from 10 to 50. Service fully recovered.

title: Notification Service Email Delivery Delays
description: Email notifications are delayed by 15-30 minutes. SMS and push notifications unaffected.
impact: Email delay for transactional emails. ~10,000 emails queued.
workaround: SMS and push notifications are functioning normally.

title: Authentication Service Latency Spike
description: Auth service p99 latency increased to 8 seconds. Login success rate dropped to 60%.
impact: Login failures affecting all user-facing services.
root_cause: Redis cache for session tokens evicted due to memory pressure from a runaway background job.
resolution: Killed runaway background job. Increased Redis memory limit. Session cache repopulated.

title: Order Service Database Deadlock
description: Order creation failing with database deadlock errors. 100% order failure rate.
impact: Complete order creation failure for 1 hour 15 minutes.
root_cause: New query in v2.3.1 caused circular locking between orders and inventory tables.
resolution: Rolled back to v2.3.0. Fixed locking order. Redeployed v2.3.2.

title: SSL Certificate Expiry - Partner API
description: SSL certificate for partner API endpoint expired. All partner integrations failing.
impact: All third-party partner integrations broken. B2B orders failing.
root_cause: Automated certificate renewal cron job silently failed 30 days prior due to DNS misconfiguration.
resolution: Manually renewed certificate. Fixed DNS configuration. Added redundant alerting.

title: Load Balancer Health Check Misconfiguration
description: Load balancer marking 2 of 5 backend instances as unhealthy, reducing capacity by 40%.
impact: Reduced backend capacity causing slower response times across all services.
workaround: Scale up additional instances to compensate.

title: Payment Gateway DB Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: Payment gateway failing to process transactions due to DB connection pool exhaustion.
root_cause: Increase in payment volume without corresponding pool size increase.
resolution: Increased DB connection pool size from 20 to 100. Added auto-scaling policy.

title: Payment Service DNS Resolution Failure
description: Payment service unable to resolve upstream processor DNS after network configuration change.
impact: All payment processing failed for 45 minutes.
root_cause: DNS misconfiguration in new deployment. Custom DNS resolver removed from service config.
resolution: Rolled back deployment to previous version. Restored DNS resolver config.

title: Payment Gateway Blocked by Firewall Rule
description: New payment processor IP range blocked by network firewall after IP block list update.
root_cause: IP block list update incorrectly included payment processor IP range.
resolution: Removed payment processor IPs from block list. Added them to allowlist.

title: Product Catalog API Slow Response
description: Product catalog API response times increased to 3-5 seconds. Normal is less than 200ms.
impact: Slow page loads on product listing and search result pages.
workaround: Enabling aggressive caching at the CDN layer reduces impact.

title: Kubernetes Cluster Certificate Rotation
description: Kubernetes cluster certificates expiring in 7 days. Planned rotation required.
impact: Planned maintenance window: Sep 20, 2026 01:00-06:00 UTC. Services may experience brief restarts.
